title: Vibrant Indian Curry
description: A flavorful and colorful Indian-inspired curry made with vibrant vegetables and spices. This dish is perfect for a gluten-free meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Add sliced bell peppers and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in curry sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
